description: Read the tenant's inventory health policy, as the Health score section of Company Settings shows it: the health-score factor weights and days-of-supply bands, the portfolio health-degraded alert's drop threshold and lookback, and the target service level and ordering cost behind safety stock and order quantities. Each setting lists the tenant's override (null = using the default), the value in force and the default. Change them with set_inventory_health_settings.
name: get_inventory_health_settings
title: Inventory Health Settings
